snippet.title: Everything is Crab | Official Mobile and Console Trailer
snippet.description:
Everything is Crab is evolving onto new platforms

Everything is Crab is launching on Android and iOS this year on November 24th!

Console players won't have to wait long before the evolution reaches them, as Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5, AND XBOX Series X|S will be launching on January 26th next year alongside new Microsoft Store and Mac versions!

All platforms will feature the same content as the PC version, including any new updates that come to the game. Wherever you play, carcinisation will follow! 🦀
